OVERVIEW · QUANTIFY · PRIORITIZE · MITIGATE · COMMUNICATE
The iARM™ Framework
Four interlocking pillars — Quantify, Prioritize, Mitigate, Communicate — turning operational event history into quantified financial exposure using actuarial methods from reinsurance and credit risk.

PILLAR 1 · QUANTIFY · ERP DATA
ERP Event Data Entry
Raw unplanned cost events loaded from ERP history — downtime hours, production loss, parts, labor, environmental, regulatory, and safety costs — parameterizing the actuarial model from real folio data.
CLICK TO EXPAND
PILLAR 1 · QUANTIFY · FREQUENCY
Poisson Frequency Distribution
Event frequency modeled as a Poisson process (λ). The distribution of annual event counts anchors the stochastic simulation and separates how often failures occur from how much they cost.
CLICK TO EXPAND
PILLAR 1 · QUANTIFY · SEVERITY
Lognormal Severity Distribution
Per-event cost modeled as lognormal — capturing the right-skewed reality of industrial losses with a fat tail. Median and mean annotations expose the gap that average-only thinking obscures.
CLICK TO EXPAND
PILLAR 1 · QUANTIFY · COMPOUND LOSS
Annual Loss Distribution
Monte Carlo simulation compounds Poisson frequency and lognormal severity into a full annual loss distribution. EAL, VaR, and TVaR percentile markers define the risk landscape in financial terms.
CLICK TO EXPAND
PILLAR 1 · QUANTIFY · JOINT DISTRIBUTION
3D Joint Distribution Surface
The compound Poisson-lognormal joint distribution visualized in three dimensions — event count vs. per-event cost — with annual loss contours overlaid. Cross-section slices expose tail behavior at any frequency.

PILLARS 2 & 3 · PRIORITIZE · MITIGATE
Tail Risk Prioritization & Mitigation
Assets ranked by tail contribution to portfolio risk. Mitigation strategies modeled with frequency and severity reductions, enabling direct comparison of investment cost against tail risk eliminated.

PILLAR 3 · MITIGATE · CROSS-ASSET
Cross-Asset Mitigation Graph
Force-directed graph surfaces cascade relationships across the asset portfolio — trigger nodes, high-tail contributors, and mitigated paths visualized together so mitigation strategies target systemic risk, not just individual assets.
